{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Ares|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Ares''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Lunge}} II and {{MCW|Breach}} II. It is crafted from an iron sword or iron spear, a shield, an iron helmet and a red dye, the arms of a soldier.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/lunge_breach.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Ares" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Ares is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Lunge applies to spears and Breach to maces.
